Hi Rajiv — thanks for reaching out and for sharing the SIG snippet. Happy to help. Two access paths we typically offer:

1) Redacted executive summary (fast)
   - We can provide a sanitized executive summary with all customer-identifying details, internal IPs, and exact intrusion timelines removed.
   - Delivery: within 2 business days once the request is accepted.
   - Attachments: ExecSummary_Redacted_v1.pdf (sample)

2) Full report access (controlled)
   - Requires a signed mutual NDA with the redaction and handling terms agreed (we use DocuSign).
   - Report delivery: secure S3 transfer + ephemeral credentials, or an SFTP share. Access window is typically 10 business days.
   - We redact third-party CIs and internal-only syscall traces by default; additional redactions can be negotiated.

Attached I'm including: Draft_NDA_For_Acme.docx and our RedactionGuidelines_v1.docx that shows the categories we remove. A couple of notes:
- We do not share raw exploit scripts or internal-only forensic logs; auditors can request sample evidence which we will provide under the same NDA.
- We can provide a short remediation status CSV showing which findings were closed, mitigated, or are still being tracked.

If your legal prefers, send back an NDA redline and we'll route to our security counsel. If this looks good, I can kick off the DocuSign and prepare the redacted exec summary.

Best,
Irene Choi

Redwood Inference
